tasks.short: Troubleshoot and repair turbine control components

steps.what: Find and read the current turbine-specific approved maintenance documents and actual work scope in the maintenance-management system {OTHER}.
outputs: Current turbine-specific source instructions and scope

steps.what: Troubleshoot actual mechanical, hydraulic or electrical malfunctions in variable pitch, variable speed, converter or related components through authorised physical examination and testing under existing site controls.
outputs: Actual diagnostic observations and fault evidence

steps.what: Determine and check the actual repair scope against the observed fault, current instructions, competence and existing work authorisation before physical repair.
outputs: Checked actual repair scope and conditions

steps.what: Repair the actual mechanical, hydraulic or electrical malfunction within the checked scope and existing authorised turbine-maintenance controls.
inputs: Exact checked repair scope from s3

steps.what: Check the actual repair result using the existing authorised verification procedure and identify unresolved faults or escalation needs.
outputs: Actual verified result and unresolved issues

steps.what: Write and check actual fault evidence, repair work, parts used and verification result in the maintenance work-record draft {OTHER}.
inputs: Actual fault, work and result from s2-s5

steps.what: Save the exact checked actual maintenance record in the maintenance-management system {OTHER}.
inputs: Exact actual record checked in s6
outputs: Saved actual diagnostic and repair record

tasks.design: Configure native turbine-model and revision views for approved instructions in the maintenance-management system {OTHER}. The technician retains actual troubleshooting, repair decisions, physical work and result checks, then writes the real work record and separately saves it.
tasks.previous_blocker: Current turbine-specific documents are found across maintenance folders.
tasks.still_hard: Interacting faults and actual physical equipment condition.
tasks.human_edge: Direct diagnosis, repair skill and recognising limits of the available evidence.

ambition.what: No autonomous repair or plant-control service is assumed.

tasks.altitude: Slightly less document lookup; maintenance authority remains unchanged.

reach.task: Record a traceable fault and repair result

evidence.claim: Native asset and revision filters can shorten approved-instruction retrieval while turbine diagnosis and repair remain physical skilled work.

assumptions: Boundary includes actual troubleshooting/repair and the existing work record. Shares are E1 estimates rather than measured turbine-maintenance baselines. No technical operating parameters or new repair procedure are generated.

Existing document owners supply asset/model id, applicable component, instruction id and approved revision. Technician obtains the real source in s1, produces actual diagnostic evidence in s2, determines scope in s3 and captures the actual completed result in s6. Missing or conflicting sources require manual retrieval and authorised escalation, not guessed instructions.

Test native source views before code. Existing access, isolation, work-permit and competence controls remain fully in the actual work; they are not replaced by software or newly added approval labour. Repair checking does not itself authorise operational restart.

Ordinary scope and final-record checks provide requested gates. Changes in scope or actual record void the relevant gate. No saving on physical work, new factual record content, existing runtime or short same-system save.
research_questions: Does asset-linked retrieval reduce actual lookup while excluding obsolete or inapplicable instructions?

already_counted.description: Residual instruction reading, actual diagnosis, scope decisions, repair, verification, record and save remain counted.

incremental.description: Maintain approved asset and document-revision links.

approvals.approved_version: Exact actual repair scope and conditions checked in s3
Exact actual work record checked in s6

time_saved_range_pct.basis: 10 x 30% actual instruction retrieval reduction = 3 gross less 0.5 upkeep. Already linked sources yield zero; physical and record work retains all time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Physically count and inspect actual tools and spare parts required for repair, installation or replacement services, identifying condition and missing items.
inputs: Existing item identifiers and storage locations
outputs: Actual item counts, condition and observed gaps

steps.what: Arrange and store the actual counted tools and parts appropriately, keeping physically identified unusable or unclear items separate under existing stores practice.
inputs: Actual counted items and condition from s1
outputs: Actually organised stock and segregated exceptions

steps.what: Capture the actual item, location, quantity and condition observations in the inventory working draft of the maintenance-management system {OTHER}.
inputs: Actual count and condition observations from s1

steps.what: Compare actual captured counts with the existing recorded balances and approved stock requirements in the maintenance inventory system {OTHER}.
inputs: Existing recorded balances and approved stock requirements

steps.what: Resolve actual inventory differences against physical evidence and work requirements, deciding justified corrections and needed replenishment within the technician's scope.
outputs: Actual verified correction and replenishment decisions

steps.what: Write the actual inventory correction draft and reason from verified count evidence in the maintenance inventory system {OTHER}.
Prepare the actual brief replenishment request with selected part, quantity and work reference in the maintenance system {OTHER}.
Check the completed correction and replenishment request against actual counts, condition, part identity, required quantity and intended stores recipient.
outputs: Checked exact correction, request and recipient

steps.what: Commit the exact checked inventory correction in the maintenance inventory system {OTHER}.
Send the exact checked replenishment request to the verified internal stores recipient through the maintenance system {OTHER}.
inputs: Exact request and stores recipient checked in s8

tasks.design: Configure native inventory defaults and count-versus-balance comparisons in the maintenance-management system {OTHER}. Actual count, condition, physical organisation and correction/replenishment decisions stay human, with explicit capture and separate checked update and internal request actions.
tasks.previous_blocker: Actual count rows are manually copied and compared to recorded stock requirements.
tasks.enabler_now: Native inventory forms and exact quantity comparisons.
tasks.still_hard: Item identity, serviceability and reasons for a discrepancy.
tasks.human_edge: Seeing the real stock and judging what is actually usable and needed.

ambition.what: No autonomous parts purchase or serviceability decision is assumed.

tasks.altitude: Less mechanical reconciliation; stock judgment remains unchanged.

reach.learn: Item identity, count evidence and justified replenishment

evidence.claim: Native count-entry forms and exact balance comparisons can reduce inventory clerical work while physical counts and condition judgments remain human.

assumptions: Conditional baseline includes actual manual count capture/comparison and existing correction/request work. Shares are E1 estimates, not measured stockroom baselines. No new formal inventory report is invented.

Technician produces actual item id, location, quantity and condition in s1 and captures them explicitly in s3. Existing stock processes supply recorded balance, movement references and approved requirements; their labour is unchanged. Missing identifiers or requirements require manual investigation in s5, not an invented par-level feed.

Test native forms and comparisons first. s3 only reduces repeated item/location fields; actual counts and condition entry remain. s4 replaces real manual arithmetic/comparison only, not existing automatic runtime. Purchasing, parts delivery and any other worker's labour remain unchanged and receive no saving.
Ordinary final-content checks follow both completed drafts and bind separate commit and internal send. Edits void gates; there is no added self-approval stage. Short save/send time is fully retained.
research_questions: Can native comparisons reduce clerical effort while preserving unresolved identity, condition and movement discrepancies?

already_counted.description: Actual physical stock work, residual capture, discrepancy judgment, actual drafts, final checks and actions remain counted.

incremental.description: Maintain item/location mappings and approved comparison requirements.

approvals.approved_version: Exact actual inventory correction checked in s8
Exact actual replenishment request and internal stores recipient checked in s8

time_saved_range_pct.basis: 15 x 20% repeated capture fields + 15 actual manual comparison = 18 gross less 1.5 upkeep. Existing native comparisons yield zero; physical and judgment work remains.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Train others in wind technical procedures

steps.what: Find and read the current approved wind commissioning, testing or technical training material in {DOCS} for the actual equipment and learner group.
Adapt the actual explanation and supervised demonstration to learner experience, equipment and the existing authorised training setting.
outputs: Actual training approach within approved scope

steps.what: Train end-users, distributors, installers, or other technicians in wind commissioning, testing, or other technical procedures through actual explanation and supervised practice within existing controls.
outputs: Actual instruction and observed learner practice

steps.what: Assess actual learner understanding and observed practice, identifying limits and further training needs without inferring competence from attendance.
inputs: Actual learner practice and responses from s3

steps.what: Write and check the actual brief training-delivery and assessment entry in the existing training record {LMS}.
inputs: Actual instruction and assessment from s3-s4

steps.what: Save the exact checked actual training entry in {LMS}.
inputs: Exact actual entry checked in s5

tasks.design: Configure native equipment, learner-group and revision views for approved sources in {DOCS}. The technician retains actual adaptation, instruction, supervised practice and assessment, then writes and separately saves only actual learning evidence in {LMS}.
tasks.previous_blocker: Current equipment-specific training sources are manually located.
tasks.enabler_now: Native source tags and version views.
tasks.still_hard: Actual learner understanding and performance in a technical setting.

ambition.what: No automatic certification or wider training service is assumed.

tasks.altitude: Less source retrieval; training authority stays unchanged.

reach.learn: Evidence-based learning assessment and competence boundaries

evidence.claim: Native approved-source views can assist training preparation without replacing live instruction and observation.

assumptions: Boundary includes actual technical training and its existing brief record. Shares are E1 estimates, not measured training baselines. No new detailed report or automatic competence certificate is invented.

Existing training owners supply equipment/model, audience, procedure source id and approved revision. Technician reads sources in s1, adapts actual instruction in s2 and produces observed learning in s3-s4. Missing tags require manual source reading; attendance and calendar end never prove competence.

Test native source views first. Existing site, equipment and training authorisations remain unchanged and fully part of actual delivery. No generated technical procedure, automatic control action or transfer of learner effort is credited as saving.
Ordinary completed-entry checking supplies the requested save gate without extra self-approval labour; edits void it. Save time remains short and full, with no existing-runtime saving.
research_questions: Can native revision and audience filtering shorten lookup while preserving all equipment-specific limitations?

already_counted.description: Residual source reading, actual adaptation, delivery, assessment and record work remain counted.

incremental.description: Maintain approved training-source tags and revisions.

approvals.approved_version: Exact actual training entry checked in s5

time_saved_range_pct.basis: 15 x 30% source retrieval reduction = 4.5 gross less 0.5 upkeep. Already indexed sources yield zero; actual training and record work remains.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Physical diagnosis, repair, stock judgment and training remain human.
role.ambitious_version: A technician who finds current sources and reconciles stock faster while retaining direct turbine work, actual observations and responsible training.
